'''2022 Jawa Cup''' was the Players Committee Jawa Format event on GEMP, November 2021 – 13 February 2022. [[Kevin Jaap]] defeated [[Ryan Jellison]] in the Final Confrontation.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2021-jawa-cup-top-8/</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Jawa Format]]
* '''Site:''' GEMP
* '''Dates:''' November 2021 – 13 February 2022
